title: The wavelength of moving matter
hook: Change momentum magnitude and predict de Broglie wavelength.
misconception: de Broglie wavelength doubles when momentum magnitude doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply λ = h/p to compare de Broglie wavelength when momentum magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a particle with nonzero momentum, λ = h/p. When momentum magnitude doubles, de Broglie wavelength becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model λ = h/p; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a particle with nonzero momentum, with a nonzero initial result. If momentum magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on de Broglie wavelength?
recall.why: Apply λ = h/p under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
